title: Herd mop-up: exit-code normalization + fswatch fixes
description: Human-approved fixes from the uvv/zz0 retro debt (2026-08-12). Two implementation ticks, run on the herd substrate; the fswatch tick is deliberately routed to a CODEX worker via runners.toml tier — doubling as the production cross-vendor experiment the user asked for.
acceptance_criteria: ExitNoRepo(3)/ExitNotFound(4) used consistently by every command that can hit those conditions (audit table in the review); fswatch watches a late-created .tick/logs/herd and clears its header error after recovery, both pinned by tests; full suite green; CHANGELOG entries for observable exit-code changes.
